data.body: P2: Coverage checker falsely passes rendered-incomplete tables: indented duplicate/missing rows are ignored, blank lines split a GFM table but rows are still counted, and an overflow fourth cell can satisfy an empty Reason. Parse each named table as one contiguous block with normalized allowed indentation and exact cells, reject malformed/extra cells, and add all four negative regressions.

P3: Route M0-ADD-03 to bn-23g, which owns verify --plan/ORACLE_UNAVAILABLE, with acceptance that unsupported collection/existence classes remain leads and do not promote. Also distinguish the bn-wog M2.10 edit from bn-73w M1-only reconciliation.

P3: INV-33 rationale supports qualifying Teapot findings but does not justify the fixed synonym-ban lint. State a concrete agent-interface/evaluation purpose for the vocabulary restriction, or cut/narrow that unsupported part.

data.reason: Fix malformed-table false passes in the ADR coverage checker; route out-of-class lead acceptance to bn-23g and M2.10 explicitly; justify or narrow INV-33 synonym lint.

data.body: Fixed the coverage parser to validate each named table as one contiguous block. It normalizes zero to three spaces of indentation, checks header and row widths, and requires content in the actual Reason cell. Added permanent regressions for the four reported cases, kept the earlier mutations, and added valid indented rows with literal pipes.

Fixed the tracker routing. bn-23g now owns the ORACLE_UNAVAILABLE plan and refusal before any send for explicit collection and existence leads, with acceptance that both retain lead status. The ADR directs the Tier 1 referee edit to bn-wog independently of the bn-73w M1 reconciliation.

Expanded INV-33's rationale with the cold-agent concept check. The lint covers agent-facing catalog strings so help, status and next commands use one name for each object. Calling a lead a candidate or hypothesis can suggest a second object or direct the agent to Investigation commands. Teapot findings still identify their owning tool.

Remaining P2 at 2ae5fdb: appending a plain prose line immediately after the last table row without a blank renders as another GFM row with empty Disposition/Reason, but the checker ignores it. Wrapping the full table in a tilde code fence also passes while rendering code. Enforce blank boundaries adjacent to each canonical table and reject fence/comment wrappers in the section; add both exact regressions.

data.body: Fixed both boundary gaps. The checker requires blank lines around each named table and tracks top-level code fences and HTML comments before it identifies table sections. The regression tests cover adjacent prose, tilde and backtick fences, HTML comments around the table or its heading, and a comment-only Reason cell. All seven earlier tests still pass.
